items.title: Our software engineering interviews are changing (a little)
items.summary: Over the last few years, LLMs have changed how software gets built and that’s no different for us at Jane Street. Most of our engineers now use them every day not only for writing code, but also for reading, debugging, and reviewing code, and plenty of things that aren’t code at all.

items.title: Diversification All the Way Down
items.summary: Diversification is not a one-time decision. It should be applied within factors, across factors, and even across time if the goal is to build a more robust multifactor portfolio.
